gen-gf-sedan-fs-bespoke-sans: Soft brush-pressed curves, gently traditional. Sedan leads with a light thick-thin shift, while Bespoke Sans follows in sharp, refined sans lines with generous gaps where curves meet stems, so paragraphs stay easy to move through.
gen-gf-sedan-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Sedan SC speaks with quiet authority and classic poise. Its strokes shift just enough to notice, and Bespoke Sans sits beneath it with sharp, refined, low-contrast sans-serif lines, so the serif and the sans-serif each keep their own job.
gen-gf-seymour-one-fs-literata: Seymour One has closed, stitched-looking curves and spacing wide enough to slip another letter between its characters, gently modulated throughout. Literata answers with open-mouthed curves in a bookish classic serif.
gen-gf-shanti-fs-literata: Literata brings a mellow swing from thick to thin, with open-mouthed curves and a sturdy, bookish serif feel. Shanti above it is light and unpinched, so the round headings and the textured body sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-share-fs-literata: Literata reads as a bookish text serif, with sturdy thin lines and a mild pen-like swing in its weight. Share's bristle-tight headings give the pair its sharpest edge.
gen-gf-share-tech-fs-literata: Literata is the bookish voice here. Share Tech is better at blunt, marker-round headings with a flat fineliner line, while Literata's classic serif strokes, medium in contrast and free of sharp hairlines, handle the sustained reading.
gen-gf-share-tech-mono-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with low contrast and generous gaps between curve ends and stems. And Share Tech Mono sets typewriter-width letters with pipe-like strokes above it, structured and precise.
gen-gf-shippori-antique-fs-literata: Literata brings a bookish serif texture, a light shading running through each word, with sturdy thin lines and open curves. And Shippori Antique earns its keep in big, short headings, where its bent-tubing forms and technical-pen line stand out.
gen-gf-shippori-antique-b1-fs-literata: Stout, pipe-cleaner strokes with open-ended curves define Shippori Antique B1, a neon-tube constant line from end to end. It excels at bold headings, while Literata's narrowing serif strokes carry the bookish detail.
gen-gf-shippori-mincho-fs-bespoke-sans: Pulled-back terminals mark Shippori Mincho, with thin strokes only slightly lighter than thick ones. And Bespoke Sans handles the running text, with sharp sans-serif lines and generous spacing, while the heading supplies the literary flavor.
